items.title: OpenAI gets $11 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation, source says | Reuters
items.summary:
Nov 6 (Reuters) - OpenAI has closed ‌on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round ​that values the company ​at $1.25 trillion, a source familiar with ⁠the matter said on Friday.

The $11 ​billion raised so far represents ​only a portion of OpenAI's original target of up to $30 billion, while ​the company's valuation has ​come down from the $1.5 trillion level it ‌had ⁠initially sought, two investors said. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

Advertisement · Scroll to continue

SoftBank and MGX participated in the funding, the investors said.

Bloomberg News reported ​on the ​funding ⁠earlier on Friday.

Sentiment toward AI companies has ​cooled in the last ​month, ⁠with some investors valuing rival Anthropic's planned IPO at about $1.5 ⁠trillion, ​below earlier expectations ​of roughly $2 trillion. [...] Reporting by Prathik Jayaprakash in ​Bengaluru; Editing by Leroy Leo

Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles.

items.title: OpenAI kicks off charm offensive to change voters' view of data centers | Reuters
items.summary:
SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 5 (Reuters) - Stunning ​victories by Democrats in US midterm elections this week have been interpreted by many as Americans repudiating tech ‌industry plans to build data centers across the country. OpenAI has now embarked on new strategies to change their minds.

The AI lab on Thursday laid out policies — in the works since August — intended to help the company build more trust with local communities and convince them that data centers will ​benefit them. [...] OpenAI officials, along with many of their peers in tech, ​have spent the last ⁠two years trying to build ties with the administration of US President Donald Trump in hopes of shaping federal policy around AI.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman donated $1 million to Trump's inaugural committee and later attended Trump's second inauguration. Last year, Brockman donated $25 million in his personal capacity to ⁠a Trump ​super PAC. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

OpenAI said it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements with public officials when negotiating or discussing future sites, although ​proprietary information would still be under wraps. It will also give residents access to construction plans ⁠and their potential effect on traffic, noise and lighting.

items.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC
items.summary:
OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar on Friday said the company will continue to invest in artificial intelligence infrastructure, even after voters strongly rebuked data centers during Tuesday's midterm elections. [...] OpenAI depends on data centers to train its AI models and serve customers, and Friar said she doesn't think the midterms dramatically changed anything for the company.

"If the midterm means more focus on data centers and communities, we're going to keep doing the work to get into those communities and to build trust with them," Friar said. [...] "When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet that customer demand," Friar told CNBC's Sara Eisen in an interview at the Citi TMT Leadership Summit at California's Pebble Beach. "It starts early with having built relationships with all of the hyperscalers, and it will continue to mean that we raise capital."

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits affair, board to launch investigation
items.summary:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having a romantic relationship with a suspected Chinese spy in a message to his company, and the company's board announced an independent investigation Sunday.

Why it matters:The scandal raises national security concerns involving one of the world's most powerful tech CEOs, who has pushed to loosen restrictions on selling advanced AI chips to China amid the two countries' race for technological dominance. [...] "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did."
   Huang said he took "full responsibility" for his actions, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders.
   "Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life," Huang wrote. "I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence." [...] The woman, Alice Huang, was recruited to seek information and potentially push for Nvidia's advanced chips to be made available in China, countering existing restrictions, the Times reported. 

What they're saying:"Today's news will not slow NVIDIA. Jensen is committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption," John Rizzo, head of public policy communications at Nvidia said in a statement.

items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces scrutiny over alleged affair with Chinese spy | PBS News
items.summary:
Lawmakers, investors and tech leaders are assessing bombshell revelations about Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang. Huang admitted to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. Nvidia designs chips and processors that power artificial intelligence and underpin much of the enormous investment in the industry. William Brangham reports.

## Read the Full Transcript

Notice: Transcripts are machine and human generated and lightly edited for accuracy. They may contain errors. [...] William Brangham:

The head of one of the companies' most critical to the development of artificial intelligence, Jensen Huang, admitted to having an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, a Chinese tech executive and suspected spy in the pink dress. There's no relation. [...] Guo Jiakun, Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson (through interpreter):

We have previously responded to this matter. The so-called claims of a Chinese spy narrative are purely a groundless accusation.

William Brangham:

Jensen Huang, in a statement yesterday, admitted to the affair in a company-wide statement -- quote -- "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry."

items.title: BLG ends T1’s streak, wins 3-1 to reach Worlds final vs Gen.G - CHOSUNBIZ
items.summary:
T1, the League of Legends (LoL) esports team, ended its 13-year undefeated record in multi-game series against Chinese teams at the World Championship (Worlds). Its bid for a fifth straight finals appearance and an unprecedented four-peat also fell short.

On the 9th in Allen, Texas, T1 lost to China's Bilibili Gaming (BLG) 1-3 in sets in the semifinals of the 2026 LoL World Championship. [...] After dropping Game 1, T1 took Game 2 to even the series. But it lost Games 3 and 4 in a row and failed to reach the final.

The loss also ended T1's run of three straight Worlds titles. T1 finished runner-up in 2022 after losing the final to DRX, then beat Weibo Gaming (WBG) in 2023, BLG in 2024, and kt Rolster last year to win the championship. It reached the final four years in a row starting in 2022 and won all of the last three events. [...] BLG, meanwhile, reached the final by avenging its loss to T1 in the 2024 Worlds final. BLG will face Korea's Gen.G for the Summoner's Cup, the championship trophy, at 4 a.m. (Korea time) on the 15th at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York.

Gen.G advanced first to the final by sweeping China's Invictus Gaming (IG) 3-0 in sets in the semifinal held the previous day.

items.title: BLG ends T1’s streak, wins 3-1 to reach Worlds final vs Gen.G - CHOSUNBIZ
items.summary:
T1, the League of Legends (LoL) esports team, ended its 13-year undefeated record in multi-game series against Chinese teams at the World Championship (Worlds). Its bid for a fifth straight finals appearance and an unprecedented four-peat also fell short.

On the 9th in Allen, Texas, T1 lost to China's Bilibili Gaming (BLG) 1-3 in sets in the semifinals of the 2026 LoL World Championship. [...] After dropping Game 1, T1 took Game 2 to even the series. But it lost Games 3 and 4 in a row and failed to reach the final.

The loss also ended T1's run of three straight Worlds titles. T1 finished runner-up in 2022 after losing the final to DRX, then beat Weibo Gaming (WBG) in 2023, BLG in 2024, and kt Rolster last year to win the championship. It reached the final four years in a row starting in 2022 and won all of the last three events. [...] BLG, meanwhile, reached the final by avenging its loss to T1 in the 2024 Worlds final. BLG will face Korea's Gen.G for the Summoner's Cup, the championship trophy, at 4 a.m. (Korea time) on the 15th at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York.

Gen.G advanced first to the final by sweeping China's Invictus Gaming (IG) 3-0 in sets in the semifinal held the previous day.
